lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2N2O8 (MnNO4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors (2.01–2.09 Å), while N adopts a four-coordinate environment with two N and two O neighbors (1.24–1.35 Å). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and between N-centered four-vertex polyhedra.
